hook.name: ZayyanXPADHook
hook.description: Volatility-scaled fee hook for Zayyan XPAD pools that charges a bps fee on the quote side (currency0) of every swap; the rate scales linearly between baseFeeBps and maxFeeBps based on the previous swap's tick movement. Fees accumulate as ERC-6909 claims inside the pool manager and can be permissionlessly swept to the pad's fee wallet.
